scripts.deploy: pnpm run symlink-articles && echo ${BRANCH:-national} && pnpm run gen-events && pnpm run styles-build && zola --config branch-zola-configs/"${BRANCH:-national}.zola.toml" build && head -6 public/index.html && wrangler deploy --config branch-wrangler-configs/"${BRANCH:-national}.wrangler.toml"
scripts.dev: pnpm run symlink-articles && pnpm run gen-events && pnpm run styles-build && zola --config branch-zola-configs/"local.${BRANCH:-national}.zola.toml" build --base-url /  && cargo install --locked worker-build ; wrangler dev --local
scripts.set-vars: GITHUB_VARNAME=APP_PRIVATE_KEY APP_VARNAME=GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY npm run set-worker-var && GITHUB_VARNAME=TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY APP_VARNAME=TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY npm run set-worker-var && GITHUB_VARNAME=DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN APP_VARNAME=DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN npm run set-worker-var
scripts.create-new-branch: cp branch-wrangler-configs/seattle.wrangler.toml branch-wrangler-configs/${BRANCH}.wrangler.toml && cp branch-zola-configs/local.seattle.zola.toml branch-zola-configs/local.${BRANCH}.zola.toml && cp branch-zola-configs/seattle.zola.toml branch-zola-configs/${BRANCH}.zola.toml && jq '. += [env.BRANCH]' branches.json > temp.json && mv temp.json branches.json
